item.name: Gem of True Sight

effects.title: Reveal
effects.text: Gives True Sight over a 300 radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.

effects.title: True Sight
effects.text: Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within 900 range of its carrier.

effects.title: Everlasting
effects.text: Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

item.lore:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor Maelrawn the Tentacular,
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.
